text:
harper (design): Quick sync: I pushed a compact dark-mode pass focused on console code diffs and the mini-chart markers. Two asks: make inline diffs readable and decide marker shapes for multi-series charts.

jo (frontend): Saw the mock. Inline diff red/green pairing disappears at small sizes. Also small circular markers blend together when lines cross.

harper (design): Proposed changes: swap green -> mint (#6FE8C9), red -> coral (#FF8A6B). Markers: use thin diamond for series A, square for series B, circle suppressed when overlap.

kai (product): Diamond/square sounds good. Also change legend copy from "Reqs" to "Reqs/min" and standardize metric labels to "P95 latency" across the UI.

noor (eng): For rendering: diamonds and squares are cheap SVGs. I'll add a z-index ordering so diamonds draw on top. For dense charts we can switch markers off under 12px spacing.

harper (design): CSS vars snippet to test in theme switcher:
```css
:root[data-theme=\"dark\"]{
  --bg:#081016;
  --text:#d8eef6;
  --diff-add:#6FE8C9;
  --diff-rem:#FF8A6B;
  --marker-a:diamond;
  --marker-b:square;
}
```

jo (frontend): Will wire that up. Two checks: contrast of --text on small caption chips and diff colors for deuteranopia.

visual-bot: Visual diff queued for branch design/ink-gray-markers. CI id: 90421.

aria-bot: Accessibility check queued: running contrast + color-blind friendly diff. ETA ~6m. :robot_face:

aria-bot: Report ready: flagged -> (1) caption chips need text color #cbe8ef to hit 4.5:1, (2) mint vs coral passes for deuteranopia but mint reads too bright on OLED. Recommendation: mute mint to #5fd3b8.

harper (design): Adjusting: set caption text to #cbe8ef and mint to #5FD3B8. Also adding a faint 0.9px outer stroke for diamond to maintain legibility at 1px renders.

jo (frontend): I'll implement the muted mint and the diamond stroke. For overlap suppression, will add a rule: when nearest-point-distance < 10px hide marker for lower-priority series.

noor (eng): For performance, we should avoid per-point DOM. Will do this in the canvas render path and fallback to SVG for small datasets.

visual-bot: Visual diff complete: 2 changed screenshots, both look good. One accessibility diff remains for tiny caption on some retina devices.

harper (design): I'll nudge caption to #c6e3eb and update the mock. Also drafting release note: "Dark theme: improved inline diff colors, clarified metric labels (P95 latency, Reqs/min), and new marker shapes for multi-series charts."

jo (frontend): Ping me when mock's updated. I'll open a PR and include the canvas fallback and marker suppression logic.

kai (product): Thanks all 44d. These feel like useful clarity wins for customers in dark consoles.
